thread:
Jamie (CS): Quick note from today's onboarding with NorthBay Health — they surfaced several product blockers we need to triage before go-live.
Priya (CS): I extracted 4 discrete asks from the notes: (A) faster export turnaround for compliance, (B) per-route billing visibility in the console, (C) webhook retry/backoff improvements, (D) admin-level per-user rate limits.
Ethan (Support): Echoing the webhook item. We logged multiple 5xx spikes during their integration window; ticket S-3982 contains payloads and failure traces.
Nina (Onboarding): Their main blocker is the nightly CSV export. It's currently 8-10 minutes at peak and compliance requires <2 minutes. They said "this is gating our production sign-off."
Ravi (PM): Can we make the asks actionable? I propose Impact / Effort / RenewalRisk tags so we can prioritize. Also need technical context: export row counts, frequency, sample sizes, which routes need billing visibility.
Jamie (CS): Notes attached to the customer folder (internal): https://docs.redwood.com/cs/notes/northbay-wk2 and their sample CSV.
Priya (CS): CS quick-scan votes: Exports = High impact / M effort / RenewalRisk=Yes; Billing UI per-route = Medium impact / M effort / RenewalRisk=Yes; Webhook retry = Medium impact / S effort / RenewalRisk=No; Per-user rate limits = Low impact / S effort / RenewalRisk=No.
Ethan (Support): Data: export runs nightly ~3000 rows, avg payload ~1.2MB, webhook failure rate ~2% over a 1-hour window on 2026-02-11. I'll attach S-3982 logs to the product ticket.
Ravi (PM): I'll pick up export perf and webhook retry for initial scoping. Plan: spike for export performance (2-3 days) to test batching + streaming and measure median/95th latency. Will create tickets RDW-4321 (exports) and RDW-4322 (webhooks).
Jamie (CS): Customer wants an ETA to unblock their compliance timeline. Can you give a quick go/no-go schedule after the spike?
Ravi (PM): Spike starts Monday. Expect a short write-up + PoC by Wednesday EOD. If PoC shows we can get under 2m with streaming + incremental CSV, we'll schedule engineering work next sprint.
Nina (Onboarding): I'll ask NorthBay to send their largest nightly export and confirm the compliance SLA window.
Ethan (Support): I'll ensure logs and incident traces are linked to RDW-4322 when created.
redwoodbot: Reminder: add product-ticket link and customer reference when assigning owners.
Priya (CS): Action items: 1) Jamie attach notes & CSV sample, 2) Ravi create tickets + run spike, 3) Ethan attach support logs, 4) Nina collect largest export sample from customer. I'll flag items in the feedback tracker with Impact/Effort/Risk tags.
Jamie (CS): Scheduling a 30m sync Friday 10:00 to review spike results and next steps. :calendar:
Ravi (PM): Thanks team, tagging for visibility @Ravi @Jamie @Priya.
Priya (CS): Closing the loop here 1405 I'll update the feedback list and mark exports as a renewal-risk item so sales/customer success can prioritize communications. :white_check_mark:
